titleEn: Furnace Replacement in Vancouver (2026): Costs, Efficiency Ratings and How Long It Takes
titleZh: 2026年温哥华熔炉更换完整指南：费用、能效等级与工期
contentEn:
Replacing a furnace in Vancouver is not a question of if but when. The average gas furnace lasts 15 to 20 years, and units installed before 2010 are already operating beyond their efficiency peak — costing Vancouver homeowners hundreds of dollars extra in annual heating bills. A new furnace installation in Metro Vancouver in 2026 typically runs $5,500 to $11,500 fully installed, depending on efficiency rating and whether you are upgrading from a standard efficiency to a high-efficiency condensing model.

When Does a Furnace Need Replacing in Vancouver?

Vancouver's mild coastal climate means furnaces run fewer hours per year than in Interior BC, but humidity and temperature swings still take a toll. Signs your furnace needs replacing include: age over 15 years, repair costs exceeding $1,500 in a single year, uneven heating between rooms, unusual noises such as banging or rattling, and a sudden spike in your natural gas bill without a rate increase. A failing furnace rarely gives dramatic warning — the clearest signal is a pattern of increasing repair bills.

Furnace Efficiency Ratings Explained for Vancouver Homes

Modern furnaces carry an Annual Fuel Utilization Efficiency (AFUE) rating. Standard efficiency models rate 80 to 89 percent, meaning 80 to 89 cents of every dollar spent on gas becomes usable heat. High-efficiency condensing furnaces (95 to 98 percent AFUE) extract heat from exhaust gases that standard units vent outside, which is why they require special sidewall venting instead of a traditional chimney. In Vancouver's climate, the premium for a 95+ AFUE furnace typically pays back in 4 to 7 years through lower gas consumption. Both Lennox and Carrier manufacture 96 to 98 AFUE models widely available through Metro Vancouver installers.

2026 Furnace Replacement Cost in Vancouver and Metro Vancouver

Furnace installation costs in Vancouver vary based on unit efficiency, home layout, and whether your existing venting system is compatible with a high-efficiency model. Below are typical installed costs for common Vancouver home types.

Home TypeFurnace Type2026 Installed Cost
Condo / Townhouse (under 1,400 sq ft)Standard (80–89% AFUE)$4,500 – $7,000
Condo / Townhouse (under 1,400 sq ft)High-efficiency (95–98% AFUE)$6,500 – $9,500
Detached Home (1,400–2,500 sq ft)Standard (80–89% AFUE)$6,000 – $9,000
Detached Home (1,400–2,500 sq ft)High-efficiency (95–98% AFUE)$8,500 – $11,500

Permit fees for gas appliance replacements in Vancouver range from $120 to $200 and are included in most contractor quotes. The City of Vancouver and municipalities across Metro Vancouver require a gas fitting permit for any furnace replacement, which your contractor typically obtains as part of the installation package.

Planning a full renovation while replacing your furnace? Speak with Reno Stars about bundling your furnace replacement with a kitchen, bathroom, or whole-house renovation to reduce overall coordination costs and streamline the permit process.

How Long Does Furnace Installation Take?

A straightforward furnace swap — same efficiency level, same venting location — typically completes in a single day. High-efficiency condensing furnace replacements that require new sidewall venting take 2 to 3 days to account for the venting installation and mandatory gas inspection. Reno Stars coordinates directly with FortisBC and your local municipal building department to schedule the required gas inspection, so you do not need to manage multiple booking calls.

BC Government Rebates for High-Efficiency Furnaces in 2026

FortisBC offers instant rebates on high-efficiency furnaces through participating contractors. As of 2026, qualifying furnaces with a 95 percent or higher AFUE rating qualify for rebates that are applied at point of purchase, reducing your upfront cost. The CleanBC program also provides additional incentives when replacing an older furnace with a heat pump or a high-efficiency gas furnace. Your Reno Stars consultant can confirm current rebate amounts and eligibility for your specific Vancouver address at the time of your quote.

Should You Replace Your Furnace Before a Renovation?

Yes — in most cases, furnace replacement should precede a major renovation. During a renovation, walls and ceilings are opened, making it significantly easier and less expensive to run new ductwork, install zone controls, or upgrade to a high-efficiency venting system. If you are planning a kitchen remodel, bathroom renovation, or basement development, replacing the furnace at the same time avoids the cost of reopening finished walls later. Reno Stars schedules HVAC upgrades as part of the pre-demolition phase for whole-house renovations across Vancouver, Richmond, Burnaby, and other Metro Vancouver cities.

在温哥华，更换熔炉不是是否需要的问题，而是何时需要的问题。普通燃气熔炉的使用寿命为15至20年，2010年之前安装的熔炉早已超过其最佳能效期——每年让温哥华业主多花费数百加元的取暖费。2026年，大温哥华地区新熔炉安装费用通常在5,500至11,500加元之间，具体取决于能效等级以及您是从标准效率炉升级到高效冷凝炉。

温哥华的熔炉何时需要更换？

温哥华温和的沿海气候意味着熔炉每年的运行时间比BC省内陆地区少，但湿度和温度波动仍然会造成损耗。熔炉需要更换的迹象包括：使用超过15年、单次维修费用超过1,500加元、房间之间供暖不均匀、出现撞击或嘎嘎作响等异常噪音，以及天然气账单突然上涨（费率未调整的情况下）。出现问题的熔炉很少会给出戏剧性的警告——最明显的信号是维修费用不断增加的模式。

温哥华住宅熔炉能效等级解读

现代熔炉标有年度燃料利用效率（AFUE）等级。标准效率型号的等级为80%至89%，即每花费一加元的燃气中有80至89加分转化为可用热量。高效冷凝熔炉（95%至98% AFUE）从标准熔炉排出室外的废气中提取热量，这就是为什么它们需要特殊的侧壁排气而非传统烟囱。在温哥华的气候条件下，95+ AFUE熔炉的溢价通常在4至7年内通过较低的燃气消耗回本。Lennox和Carrier都生产96至98 AFUE型号，可通过大温哥华地区的安装商广泛购买。

2026年温哥华及大温地区熔炉更换费用

温哥华熔炉安装费用因设备效率、住宅布局以及您现有的排气系统是否与高效型号兼容而异。以下是常见温哥华住宅类型的典型全包安装费用。

住宅类型熔炉类型2026年全包安装费用
公寓/联排别墅（1,400平方英尺以下）标准效率（80–89% AFUE）4,500 – 7,000加元
公寓/联排别墅（1,400平方英尺以下）高效（95–98% AFUE）6,500 – 9,500加元
独立屋（1,400–2,500平方英尺）标准效率（80–89% AFUE）6,000 – 9,000加元
独立屋（1,400–2,500平方英尺）高效（95–98% AFUE）8,500 – 11,500加元

温哥华燃气设备更换许可证费用在120至200加元之间，大多数承包商报价已包含此项。温哥华市及大温哥华地区各市政当局要求对任何熔炉更换进行燃气管道安装许可，您的承包商通常作为安装服务包的一部分办理。

在更换熔炉的同时规划全面装修？与Reno Stars讨论将熔炉更换与厨房、浴室或全屋装修捆绑，以降低总体协调成本并简化许可流程。

熔炉安装需要多长时间？

简单的熔炉更换——相同效率等级、相同排气位置——通常在一天内完成。需要新侧壁排气的高效冷凝熔炉更换需要2至3天，以完成排气系统安装和强制性燃气检查。Reno Stars直接与FortisBC及您当地市政建筑部门协调，安排所需的燃气检查，因此您无需管理多个预约电话。

2026年BC省政府高效熔炉 rebate

FortisBC通过参与承包商提供高效熔炉的即时 rebate。截至2026年，符合条件的95%或更高AFUE等级熔炉可获得在购买时应用的rebate，降低您的预付成本。CleanBC计划在为现有熔炉更换为热泵或高效燃气熔炉时还提供额外激励。您的Reno Stars顾问可以在报价时确认当前rebate金额及您特定温哥华地址的资格。

装修前是否应该先更换熔炉？

是的——在大多数情况下，熔炉更换应先于重大装修进行。在装修期间，墙壁和天花板会被打开，这使得安装新的管道系统、安装区域控制或升级到高效排气系统变得更加容易且成本更低。如果您正在规划厨房改造、浴室翻新或地下室开发，同时更换熔炉可以避免以后重新打开已完成墙壁的费用。Reno Stars将HVAC升级安排为温哥华、列治文、本拿比及其他大温城市全屋装修的预拆除阶段的一部分。
